NewsArticle.Title: 40 New Circle 5 Regional Variations
NewsArticle.Content:
Wear new variations of Circle 5 clothing, which is worn at the 97th insight. In the case of warriors, it's insight varies.
A tailor and respected citizen can learn the art of regional tailoring. Go to one of the mundane tailors of the four regions: Mileth, Rucesion, Suomi, and Loures.
